title: Google Gemini Agents Beat Minecraft Without Human Help
excerpt: Four Google Gemini 4 Argon agents successfully defeated Minecraft's Ender Dragon entirely without human intervention.
body_html:
A group of four Google Gemini 4 Argon agents has successfully completed Minecraft by defeating the Ender Dragon without any human intervention.

During the process, the artificial intelligence agents coordinated their actions by sharing tips, discussing threats, and communicating about mistakes they made along the way.
